content:
Use a multi-panel 16:9 “character design sheet/character bible” prompt with front/side/back turnaround views and close-up detail panels to lock in consistent anatomy, hairstyle, clothing layers, accessories, and proportions for a Seedance character.

Add explicit layout directions (left full-body hero, center turnaround views, right close-ups) plus UI/graphic elements (cyber UI frames, labels, logo marks, glitch patterns, paint splashes, neon graffiti symbols) to control composition and presentation.

Specify an exact color palette (electric cyan, neon pink, acid green, deep black, dark gray, metallic silver) to keep style and colors consistent across generations.

Include strong style anchors (e.g., Jet Set Radio × Cyberpunk × Zenless Zone Zero, premium AAA game artbook illustration, cinematic neon lighting, clean UI interface, production-ready character bible) to steer Seedance toward a targeted aesthetic.

Add quality and constraint tags (masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, 8K, dark composition) and negatives (no watermark, no logo, no extra limbs, no deformed anatomy) to improve output cleanliness and anatomy.
